run.name: CIMPRESS plc
run.title: CP-OS host session (CMPR)
run.summary: Cimpress is a moderately leveraged, cash-generative credit whose leverage rose to 3.71x after a debt-funded acquisition while margins weakened. Liquidity of USD 317.8 million and a distant refinancing date support it. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 1,636,404 and cash 248,851 at June 30, 2026 over issuer adjusted EBITDA 458,498 for FY2026; excludes finance leases; issuer-defined EBITDA

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 458,498 over cash paid for interest 109,647 (gross; interest received 12,120)

cash.basis: Cash. Printed capacity after 35.0 of revolver borrowings and letters of credit; cash is consolidated cash, part of it held by subsidiaries

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: EBITDA is issuer-defined, and the covenant definitions, legal documents and ownership detail are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is issuer-defined and adds back share-based compensation; covenant EBITDA and the covenant ratio are not supplied.
